toolchain-doctor.description: Check the project-local Python, Picker, Verilator, and SymbiYosys toolchain.

gen-dut.description: Regenerate the ignored Picker/Verilator Python DUT wrapper from the tracked RTL.

unit-tests.description: Run project Python unit tests without rebuilding the DUT.

model-tests.description: Run targeted unit tests for the exact-way Refm, protocol properties, and fault injection.
arguments: source scripts/env.sh && PYTHONPATH=.:./dv:./Cache:./tests python3 -m pytest -q tests/unit/test_reference_model.py tests/unit/test_dut_properties.py tests/unit/test_fault_injection.py

formal-lifecycle.description: Run an 8-cycle bounded Yosys SAT check of CPU response accounting, reset cancellation, and stalled-response stability in the real CacheStage3 controller.
arguments: source scripts/env.sh && mkdir -p reports/formal && yosys -Q -l reports/formal/cache_stage3_response_lifecycle_sat.log -s formal/cache_stage3_response_lifecycle.ys

formal-status.description: Inspect active Yosys/SymbiYosys processes and memory pressure in the configured WSL environment.

report.description: Run the cache regression, coverage closure, and checker fault injection.
